tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Text and icons on light grounds. Also the dark ground of the level hero, toasts, the pack and Sleep mode, with white text.

tokens.name: night-2
tokens.usage: Second stop of the night gradient on the level hero and pack.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Screen background behind every screen. Also neutral pills and fact tiles on white.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Rows, tiles, boxes and sheets sitting on cloud. Night text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 2px inner outline on white rows, tiles and secondary buttons; dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Toggle off, sheet handle, dashed empty states, locked badges, inactive dots.

tokens.name: lip
tokens.usage: The 4px lip under white buttons and rows.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive tab labels. 4.8:1 on cloud, 5.3:1 on card.

tokens.name: sleep
tokens.usage: Brand and primary action. Also everything about sleep: icon badge, bars, Deep Sleeper. White text on it (5.2:1).

tokens.name: sleep-d
tokens.usage: Lip under primary buttons, text on sleep-t, current tab label.

tokens.name: sleep-t
tokens.usage: Sleep tile, AI summary box, current tab bubble, shared-type tile. sleep-d or night text.

tokens.name: steps
tokens.usage: Everything about steps: ring, icon badge, progress. Also connected and done states. Use for fills and icons, not for small white text.

tokens.name: steps-d
tokens.usage: Text on steps-t, the go button ground (white text 5.1:1), the balance card.

tokens.name: steps-t
tokens.usage: Steps tile, connected source row, completed quest. steps-d or night text.

tokens.name: heart
tokens.usage: Heart rate only: icon badge, pulse line, and the small notification dot on tabs.

tokens.name: heart-d
tokens.usage: Text on heart-t.

tokens.name: heart-t
tokens.usage: Heart tile and the ground of red pills.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Game rewards and money marks: level hexagon, XP bar, streak, coin, pack seal, Legendary, countdown ring. Night text on it (9.5:1).

tokens.name: gold-d
tokens.usage: Lip under gold shapes.

tokens.name: gold-t
tokens.usage: Gold pills, Sleep mode tile, countdown ring track. Text #8A5600 or night.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: A study matches a card: row outline, match box, organisation badge. Fills and outlines only.

tokens.name: sky-d
tokens.usage: Text on sky-t, lip under a matching row.

tokens.name: sky-t
tokens.usage: Match box and the match pill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Stop sharing and delete only. White text on it (5:1). Never decorative.

tokens.name: danger-d
tokens.usage: Lip under danger buttons, text of red pills, refused log rows.

styles.name: d2

styles.name: d3
styles.usage: Level name, row titles, banner title.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Prices on bounty rows, earned so far.

styles.usage: The AI summary and button labels (700).
